title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a cylindrical base by first setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face, creating a single loop within which a circle is drawn. Position the center of this circle at coordinates [0.0469, 0.0469] and set its radius to 0.0469 units. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0938 to achieve the desired dimensions. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to form a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be 0.09375 units in length, 0.09375 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the sketch along the Z-axis
)

# Scale the sketch to create the top surface
scaled_sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469 * 0.0938)  # Draw a circle with the scaled radius
)

# Extrude the scaled sketch to create the top surface
top_surface = (
    scaled_sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the sketch along the Z-axis
)

# Combine the cylinder and the top surface
r = cylinder.union(top_surface)

# Display the final model

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Draw a circle with diameter 0.0938
r = r.circle(0.0938 / 2)

# Extrude the circle to height 0.7500
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Translate the cylinder to be centered at origin
r = r.translate((0.0469, 0.0469, 0))

# Create the final solid
r = r

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Main cylinder: diameter 0.0938, length 0.75 along Z
cyl = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0938 / 2).extrude(0.75)

# Thin axial slot cut all the way through along X (visible as the center
# line in the RIGHT view and the seam on the isometric view)
slot_width = 0.003
slot = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.2, slot_width, 0.75)
    .translate((0, 0, 0.375))
)

r = cyl.cut(slot)
